{{Quote|I just got a priority message from Solash. He's another Cartel lieutenant. He's offering a huge bounty if you bring him the Eidolon. Alive.|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]], to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:PC" />}}
'''Solash''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] lieutenant of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:PC" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> [[Eidolon (assassin)|the Eidolon]], a former [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], whose company [[Eidolon Security]] was a competitor to the Cartel, became a target of the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]] and Solash posted on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] a message from [[Karagga]] the Unyielding specifically requesting that he should be brought to the Hutt Cartel alive, instead of dead.<ref name="TOR:PC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Solash appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR:PC" />
